messages:
maria_cs: Heads up — planning an adhoc healthscore recalibration tomorrow 02:00 PDT. Want to run the playbook automation in dry-run first. Affects: onboard cohort + legacy accounts with stale contacts. Query below and coordination needed.

alan_ops: What's the expected runtime window? will playbook-runner be paused for real sends?

sanjay_pm: Recommend canary + telemetry gating. If 'at-risk' population shifts >5% we abort and rollback. @zoe_enablement fyi — need to avoid spamming reps. :warning:

zoe_enablement: Can we tag all outbound nudges as [DRYRUN] and suppress external notifications? need a sample export (200 rows) of affected accounts so enablement can sanity-check templates.

maria_cs: Yep — will prefix notes with [DRYRUN]. SQL we're using for the backfill (simplified):
```sql
SELECT account_id, health_score, last_touch
FROM accounts
WHERE last_touch < now() - interval '90 days'
  AND cohort = 'onboard-2025'
ORDER BY last_touch DESC
LIMIT 2000; -- canary size
```

deploy-bot: playbook-runner: scheduled job added -> 2026-03-24T09:00:00Z (pb-8732) — mode: dry. Logs to: /var/log/playbooks/pb-8732.log

alan_ops: I'll set PLAYBOOK_DRY=true in the runner env and create a telemetry tag `health-recalc-v2`. Also will add an auto-abort check: abort if delta_at_risk > 0.05 within first 30m.

sanjay_pm: Can we limit the first canary to 2k accounts and run for 1 hour, then evaluate metrics? also capture: nudge open rate, owner-claim rate, and retention projection.

maria_cs: 2k canary approved. After dry run i'll drop a sample CSV in #cs-ops with annotations for enablement. Postmortem checklist i'll use: 1) weekly retention delta, 2) nudge open/click rate, 3) owner claim rate, 4) playbook errors. If variance >3% during canary ping me and @eng-oncall.

zoe_enablement: :thumbsup: i'll prep enablement notes + a short runbook for reps to treat these as simulated nudges. also want a rollback doc. who owns rollback?

alan_ops: I can own rollback. Quick rollback steps (commands):
```bash
# 1) stop the scheduled job
pbctl cancel pb-8732
# 2) set dry mode off (if we need to re-run safely)
export PLAYBOOK_DRY=false
# 3) revert healthscore model snapshot
modelctl promote prod-model-v1.7 --to current
# 4) re-run backfill in rollback mode
playbook-runner --id pb-8732 --mode rollback --confirm
```
I'll also snapshot current scoring table before canary: `pg_dump --table=account_scores > scores_pre_canary.sql`.

maria_cs: Thanks — adding to calendar. i'll also attach the 200-account sample to this thread after the dry run. Ping me immediately if anything shows >3% variance or unexpected owner churn. /cc @eng-oncall
